Notes on Thrift
===============

MacOS Dependencies:
-------------------
1. The package manager Homebrew is required to help install the other dependencies.
2. The Thrift autoconfigure script requires Bison >= 2.5. The standard bison included
   with MacOS is 2.3. A newer version can be installed with HomeBrew via the command
   "brew install bison". You then need to change the $PATH to use this HomeBrew version
   of bison before the inbuilt MacOS bison. You can do this by adding the following command
   to your ~/.bash_profile file:
   export PATH="$(brew --prefix bison)/bin:$PATH"
3. Thrift depends on the C++ library Boost. It can be installed with "brew install boost".
   If this is successful then there will be headers in /usr/local/include/boost.
4. Thrift depends on headers and libraries for openssl. MacOS should provide a version of
   openssl (libreSsl I believe), but it's headers are not found in the usual /usr/local/include
   path. Instead the headers are likely found in /usr/local/opt/openssl/include instead and
   the library in /usr/local/opt/openssl/lib. The build environment will adjust the CPPFLAGS
   and LD_FLAGS environment variables to also search in these locations.


CentOS 7 Dependencies:
----------------------
1. The EPEL7 (Extra Packages for Enterprise Linux) repository must be installed in yum as
   this provides an easier installation for additional packages.
2. Thrift depends on the C++ library Boost. It can be installed with "sudo yum install boost169-devel".
   If this is successful then there will be headers in /usr/include/boost169. Note that the default
   boost package (sudo yum install boost) installs an older version of boost that is less than
   the 1.56 version that Thrift requires. Additionally, because the headers get installed into a
   non-default path (/usr/local/boost169 instead of /usr/include/boost) then we need to tell the
   Thrift configure script where to find these boost libraries.
3. Thrift depends on headers and libraries for openssl. This can be installed with the command
   "sudo yum install openssl-devel". If successful, there will be headers found at /usr/include/openssl.


Ubuntu 22 Dependencies:
-----------------------
1. Thrift depends on the C++ library Boost. It can be installed with "sudo apt-get install libboost-dev".
   If this is successful then there will be headers in /usr/local/boost.
3. Thrift depends on headers and libraries for openssl. This can be installed with the command
   "sudo apt-get install libssl-dev". If successful, there will be headers found at /usr/include/openssl.


Configuring Thrift on Mac
-------------------------

The command below will build thrift and the c++ library only on MacOS.

LD_FLAGS='-L/usr/local/opt/openssl/lib' CPPFLAGS='-I/usr/local/opt/openssl/include' ./configure \
 --prefix=/Users/craig/Downloads/libthrift \
 --enable-libs \
 --disable-tests \
 --disable-tutorial \
 --disable-coverage \
 --disable-shared \
 --enable-static \
 --with-cpp \
 --without-java \
 --without-kotlin \
 --without-erlang \
 --without-nodejs \
 --without-nodets \
 --without-lua \
 --without-python \
 --without-py3 \
 --without-php \
 --without-php_extension \
 --without-dart \
 --without-ruby \
 --without-go \
 --without-swift \
 --without-rs \
 --without-haxe \
 --without-netstd \
 --without-d \
 --without-libevent \
 --without-qt5


Configuring Thrift on CentOS 7
------------------------------

The command below will build thrift and the c++ library only on CentOS 7.

./configure \
 --prefix=$(realpath ./../libthrift) \
 --enable-libs \
 --disable-tests \
 --disable-tutorial \
 --disable-coverage \
 --disable-shared \
 --enable-static \
 --with-cpp \
 --with-boost=/usr/include/boost169 \
 --without-java \
 --without-kotlin \
 --without-erlang \
 --without-nodejs \
 --without-nodets \
 --without-lua \
 --without-python \
 --without-py3 \
 --without-php \
 --without-php_extension \
 --without-dart \
 --without-ruby \
 --without-go \
 --without-swift \
 --without-rs \
 --without-haxe \
 --without-netstd \
 --without-d \
 --without-libevent \
 --without-qt5


Configuring Thrift on Ubuntu 22
-------------------------------

The command below will build thrift and the c++ library only on Ubuntu 22.

./configure \
 --prefix=$(realpath ./../libthrift) \
 --enable-libs \
 --disable-tests \
 --disable-tutorial \
 --disable-coverage \
 --disable-shared \
 --enable-static \
 --with-cpp \
 --without-java \
 --without-kotlin \
 --without-erlang \
 --without-nodejs \
 --without-nodets \
 --without-lua \
 --without-python \
 --without-py3 \
 --without-php \
 --without-php_extension \
 --without-dart \
 --without-ruby \
 --without-go \
 --without-swift \
 --without-rs \
 --without-haxe \
 --without-netstd \
 --without-d \
 --without-libevent \
 --without-qt5


Configuring Thrift on AWS Linux 2
---------------------------------

The command below will build thrift and the c++ library only on AWS Linux 2.

./configure \
 --prefix=$(realpath ./../libthrift) \
 --enable-libs \
 --disable-tests \
 --disable-tutorial \
 --disable-coverage \
 --disable-shared \
 --enable-static \
 --with-cpp \
 --with-boost=/mnt/disk2/boost_1_80_0 \
 --without-java \
 --without-kotlin \
 --without-erlang \
 --without-nodejs \
 --without-nodets \
 --without-lua \
 --without-python \
 --without-py3 \
 --without-php \
 --without-php_extension \
 --without-dart \
 --without-ruby \
 --without-go \
 --without-swift \
 --without-rs \
 --without-haxe \
 --without-netstd \
 --without-d \
 --without-libevent \
 --without-qt5
